sources.title: whisper-tiny.en: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview whisper-tiny.en is a 39-million-parameter English-only automatic speech recognition model developed by openai. It is a Transformer-based encoder-decoder sequence-to-sequence model trained on 680,000 hours of labeled speech data using large-scale weak supervision. sources.snippet: Overview whisper-tiny.en is a Transformer encoder-decoder model for English speech recognition built by openai. The model contains 39 million parameters and was trained on 680,000 hours of multilingual speech data using large-scale weak supervision, enabling it to recognize speech without fine-tuning on downstream tasks. sources.title: Whisper Tiny (English) — OpenASR Models
sources.snippet: Whisper Tiny.en is OpenAI's 39M-parameter English-only Whisper checkpoint. It uses the standard Whisper encoder-decoder architecture for automatic speech recognition, trained with large-scale weak supervision on 680k hours of labelled speech.
